Verdict: The same-helper global adapter is justified within the install mandate and skills-only constraint; a mandatory per-project brief adds friction without solving lifecycle integration.
Next: Confirm the descriptive name and scope, defaulting to all-projects if unanswered; add optional event mode while preserving direct mode and unrelated configuration. Bind captured instructions, cwd, and review state to session/owner-turn; treat captured text as untrusted context, preserve route/evidence across continuations and prompts, reset budget only for a genuine new owner turn, disable reviewer-child hooks, and let native interruption win. Through native hooks/list and exact-command/key/currentHash review, install using config/batchWrite and reload; require one native block→continuation→allow probe demonstrating context isolation, budget persistence, and no recursion, then one model-backed integration.
Risk: Missing, mismatched, or insufficient bounded/redacted context must visibly fail—not approve completion; never persist raw transcripts, attachments, or secrets, and restrict artifact lookup to the current repository’s explicitly designated review artifacts.
